blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has extended to Nov. 19 the deadline for filing tax returns and paying taxes originally due on Nov. 16 to 18, for taxpayers under the covered revenue district offices (RDOs) and large taxpayer divisions in the National Capital Region (NCR). The advisory, signed by BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza, follows Proclamation No. 1447, declaring Nov. 16 to 18 as special non-working days in NCR in connection with the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.
